traits.name: Natural Camouflage
traits.text: A tatzlwyrm's green, gray, and brown scales provide it natural camouflage. In areas of dense undergrowth, a tatzlwyrm can move at its full Speed when Sneaking, and it gains a +4 circumstance bonus to Hide.

traits.name: Poison Gasp
traits.text: ⬻ The tatzlwyrm belches a puff of poisonous vapor into the face of an adjacent creature, which must attempt a DC 15 Fortitude save; the creature takes a –2 circumstance penalty to this save if it's grabbed or flat-footed. The tatzlwyrm can't use Poison Gasp again for 2 rounds. Critical Success The target is unaffected. Success The target is sickened 1. Failure The target takes 2d6 (2d6) poison damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 round. Critical Failure The target takes 4d6 (4d6) poison damage and is enfeebled 1 for 1 minute.
